persons.name: Vāsudeva
persons.evidence: lakṣmyādinārāyaṇavāsudevau yajjitya gopiṃ dadataś ca prajñāṃ

relations.evidence: tasya prasādāc ca vijitya mārāṃl lilekha prajñāṃ sakalāṃ salakṣāṃ || yacchrīnivāso nayadharmacārī dadau vinocchrīṃ likhanāya

date.as_written: samvat .. .. .. prathamāṣāḍhe śukladvitīyāyāṃ śanaiścaradine punarvasunakṣatre yoge vṛddhi ... abde naipālike khyāte grahaṣaḍgirisaṃyute | māse tu prathamāṣāḍhe śuklapakṣe dvitīyake || punarvasau ca nakṣatre vṛddhiyoge śanair dine

purpose: mātāpitṛpūrvaṅgamaṃ kṛtvā satvarāśer anuttaraṃ dhyānaphalāptaye; anena puṇyena sukhaṃ sarājyaṃ tuṣṭas ciraṃ gacchatu śaivalokaṃ
notes: The year in digits is effaced in the prose ('samvat .. .. ..') but given as a chronogram in the concluding verse: 'graha-ṣaḍ-giri' = 9-6-7 in reverse = NS 769. Śrīnivāsa (Malla) was the crown prince under Siddhinarasiṃha Malla of Patan. Lakṣmyādinārāyaṇa and Vāsudeva are mentioned in the dual ('-vāsudevau ... tayoḥ savaṃśā') as having contributed to the copying/donation.
